description:
Advertised prize: ₹ 1,00,000

Hackathon ’27 is a national-level innovation challenge organized by the Forum of AI Developers (FAID) P. R. Pote Patil College of Engineering and Management, Amravati . The event brings together students from across India to collaborate, innovate, and build technology-driven solutions for real-world problems. Participants will work on open-ended problem statements spanning domains such as Artificial Intelligence, Industry 5.0, Education, Healthcare, Agriculture and Open Innovation. The focus of Hackathon ’27 is on system-level thinking, practical implementation, and meaningful impact rather than theoretical ideas. The competition follows a structured multi-stage process including idea submission,online evaluation, and an offline Grand Finale where shortlisted teams build andpresent their solutions live.
eligibility_text: 👨‍🔧 Engineering (All Branches) 💻 MCA / BCA / B.Sc IT 🛠 Diploma Students 📊 MBA / BBA Tech-Thinkers If you're a student with an idea — you can participate! 🚀

problem_sources.text: Healthcare systems deal with large amounts of data, processes, and human interactions, yet many workflows are still manual and disconnected. In this challenge, participants are encouraged to build an AI/ML-enabled healthcare system that improves usability, coordination, or efficiency in a real-world healthcare environment. The scope is open — teams may choose any healthcare-related problem and design a complete system where AI adds meaningful value.
problem_sources.title: 🧠 PS-01: AI/ML in Healthcare Systems

problem_sources.text: Supply chain operations involve multiple stakeholders, large datasets, and constant decision-making. However, understanding and acting on this data is often complex and slow. This challenge invites participants to build a Generative AI–powered supply chain system that helps users understand data, improve coordination, or support better decisions. Teams may choose any part of the supply chain and design a system where GenAI acts as an intelligent assistant.
problem_sources.title: 🚚 PS-02: Generative AI for Supply Chain Management

problem_sources.text: Training and Placement activities involve managing student data, skill development, evaluations, and interview preparation — often using manual or fragmented tools. In this challenge, participants are asked to build an AI-powered system that supports training and placement processes in educational institutions. The solution may focus on student readiness, assessments, mock interviews, or intelligent feedback systems.
problem_sources.title: 🎓 PS-03: AI-Driven Training & Placement Support System

problem_sources.text: Industry 5.0 emphasizes human-centric, ethical, and sustainable use of technology, where AI supports humans rather than replacing them. This challenge allows participants to design an AI-based solution for any industrial or organizational problem, focusing on human–AI collaboration, safety, sustainability, or responsible system design. The scope is open and encourages creative, practical ideas.
problem_sources.title: 🤝 PS-04: Applied AI Solutions for Industry 5.0

problem_sources.text: Not all impactful ideas fit into predefined categories. This Open Innovation Challenge is for teams who want complete freedom to solve real-world problems of their choice. Participants may identify any meaningful problem and build a technology-driven solution with a focus on usability, impact, and feasibility. There are no domain restrictions — clarity of problem and quality of solution matter most.
problem_sources.title: 🤖 PS-10: AI-Driven Drug Repurposing & Personalized Pharmacogenomics
